reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a banknote with a downward arrow, making it an intuitive symbol for withdrawing cash at an ATM, cashing out a balance, receiving a refund/payout, or lowering expenses. Its main ambiguity is directional (money coming out of an ATM vs. money coming in vs. paying out), and at tiny sizes the bill can slightly resemble a simple camera.

readings.meaning: withdraw cash or take money out
incoming payment, refund, or cash deposit
lower cost, price drop, or reduce expenses

pass1.ambiguity: The downward arrow can be read either as cash coming out of an ATM/account (withdrawal/payout) or money coming into the user's hand (deposit/refund), or as decreasing costs. At very small sizes the banknote can look like a camera or a ticket.
